entities.summary: Tanita Tikaram (b. 1969-08-12, Münster) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Münster and Malaysia. Known in the fields of malaysia, composers & musicians, asia.
